title: A late library book
instructions: Tom kütüphaneye gecikmiş bir kitap getiriyor. Ceza ve yeni kitapla ilgili bilgilere dikkat et.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Hi. I'm sorry, this book is late. I was on holiday.

script.speaker: lib
script.text: Let me check. It was due on the fifth, so it's ten days late.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: How much do I have to pay?

script.speaker: lib
script.text: It's twenty pence a day, so two pounds.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: OK. Here you are. Can I borrow the next book in the series?

script.speaker: lib
script.text: Sorry, someone has it now. But I can reserve it for you.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Yes, please. When will it come back?

script.speaker: lib
script.text: In about a week. We'll send you an email.

questions.feedback: Günlük yirmi peniden on gün: iki pound.

questions.prompt: How will Tom know the next book is back?
options: They will send him an email.
